about: Real hosts the job board links to or names (S13-071 corpus, 2026-11-03): every employer-owned host the catalogue fetches (iCIMS career sites, Ashby boards named by domain, a Pinpoint custom host), an even sample of each vendor's hosts, and the hosts written in the repository's sources, scripts and fixtures. 'listed' is the registrable domain under the full Public Suffix List (tldts 7.4.4, private section included).
